To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the best floral stage for embryogenesis induction from anther cultures in eggplant is not the same as the best stage to isolate anthers enriched in inducible microsopores and pollen.

the best anther stage for embryogenesis induction in eggplant is younger than the one most commonly used; and that the response to embryogenesis induction is not influenced by the floral morph in eggplant heterostylic accessions.
the best stage of anther excision to induce embryogenesis is younger than the most responsive stage, and that the response of short and of long-styled buds of heterostylic eggplants is similar.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the improvement of anther culture in eggplant, a crop of economic importance in the Mediterranean basin.
the improvement of anther culture efficiency in eggplant and may contribute for the development of new strategies to improve the efficiency of the method.
the optimization of anther culture in eggplant and the identification of the most suitable floral morphs for this purpose.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the best floral stage for eggplant anther culture is the youngest possible, and the best floral morph is the one that allows for the extraction of the youngest possible anther.
the most responsive microspore stage to embryogenesis induction in anthers is the young bicellular pollen and the most responsive anther stage is the mid microspore stage.

the most suitable anther stage to culture in liquid medium is the one that contains young microspores, and that the best floral stage for anther culture is the one that presents the highest percentage of anthers containing this stage.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, while the best floral stages to isolate anthers for culture are the ones containing young and mid microspheres, the best anthers are those containing mostly young microspores.
the best anther stage to be cultured is the one containing young microspores, and that anthers from short and long-stylers can be used indistinctly.

anther culture in eggplant is not limited to specific floral stages, but rather, that the culture of anthers of younger buds would allow for the growth of microspores up to the inducer stages, thus improving the embryogenic response.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the best anther stages for embryogenesis induction may be different from the stages with highest response, and this difference may be explained in terms of the anther wall thickness.
anther culture protocols should be optimized for each cultivar, and that the best floral stage for anther extraction should be determined for each one.

the best anther stage to induce embryogenesis is the one that contains young and mid microscopes, regardless of the anther age, and that the best buds to be excised are those with the shortest anther lengths.
